The '''''Lightrunner''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that belonged to [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda's]] caretaker [[Mammon Hoole]]. It was lost when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] devoured itself.
